scope: Independent human-readable source-to-model visual review; approximate coherent pavilion exterior, not survey or print certification
identity: NTHU Mei/Ji Pavilion, not Yue Han Pavilion, Yue Han Hall, or cemetery complex

findings.topology: Single continuous saddle with two opposite high free corners and two opposite low bearing corners; no false central ridge, four tall columns or enclosed rear wall. Matches official hyperbolic-shell description and complementary book upper view.
findings.supports: Two short outward-flared broad concrete supports under low corners. Model deliberately regularized and thickened; no visible top punch-through.
findings.ribs: Inset underside edge ribs preserve slender outer overhang and deep structural edge impression. Sharp regularized corners are model approximations.
findings.materials: Restrained pale warm-white/grey shell and supports, neutral floor and stone table. No invented loud color zones or false lettering.
findings.furniture: Single robust table is intentionally simplified; stools and inscriptions omitted and documented.
findings.rear_top: Useful verification views of declared approximate saddle geometry, not proof of measured rear/top. Official complementary photograph only421x286 and far-left tip touches/clips image border.
findings.front_camera: Final perspective front shows dominant raised left free corner outside the left support, broad triangular-looking soffit and two low supports. Rear raised corner remains partly visible unlike the primary source framing; camera and proportions are not photographically registered. Accepted as an approximate geometry presentation, not a matched-photo reconstruction.
findings.framing: All five delivered views personally inspected. A suspected left-oblique clipping from multi-image display was withdrawn after standalone image reread confirmed the exact f7acc415... PNG has its highest tip near y184 of1200, fully in-frame.

limitations: No verified measured plan, shell equation or exact thickness; rectangular110x90 footprint, symmetric82/16 corner heights and regularized ribs are chosen model parameters.
Official opposite-side upper roof photograph is low-resolution with unknown capture date; its edge-clipped tip precludes claiming a complete360degree photo survey.
Official front2016 and Commons2020/2025 establish appearance at source dates, not verified2026 condition.
Artificial display floor is not a surveyed site boundary; terrain, lamps/cameras/pipes, text and stools are excluded.
Review does not certify structural strength, support-free printing, physical print success or minimum-normal-wall thickness; published thin-tip and overhang warnings remain mandatory.
Front silhouette proportions and camera are not precisely registered; opposite high corner remains exposed. Do not advertise exact photographic matching or dimension recovery.
